signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in with your email and password.
signIn.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

secondFactor.title: Two-step verification
secondFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.
secondFactor.rememberDeviceHelp: Don't select this on shared computers.
secondFactor.useRecoveryCode: Don't have your phone? Use a recovery code

recovery.title: Recovery code
recovery.description: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved. Each code works only once.
recovery.left_one: You have {{count}} recovery code left. Generate new codes from My account.
recovery.left_other: You have {{count}} recovery codes left. If you are running low, generate new codes from My account.

enrolment.title: Set up two-step verification
enrolment.description: To protect the arquebusiers' data, PolvorApp asks for a code from your phone as well as your password.
enrolment.step1: Install an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or FreeOTP).
enrolment.step2: Scan the QR code or enter the setup key manually.
enrolment.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app.
enrolment.qrLabel: QR code to set up the authenticator app

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.description: If you lose your phone, you can sign in with one of these codes. They are shown only now: copy or print them and keep them somewhere safe.

invitation.title: Welcome to PolvorApp
invitation.invalidTitle: This invitation is no longer valid
invitation.invalidDescription: The link has expired, has already been used or has been replaced. Ask a Federation administrator to send you a new invitation.

password.rules: At least 12 characters. A phrase you can remember is better than a word with symbols.
password.forgotDescription: Enter your email and we will send you a link to create a new password.
password.sentDescription: If there is an account with that email, you will receive a link that is valid for one hour.
password.resetDescription: You will still need the code from your authenticator app afterwards.
password.resetDone: Password changed. You can sign in now.
password.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
password.invalidDescription: The link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one.

validation.code: Enter the 6 digits of the code.
validation.passwordLength: The password must be at least 12 characters long.

account.title: My account
account.description: Your details, your language and the security of your account.
account.name: Name
account.languageDescription: Used in the application and in the emails you receive. Change it with the language selector.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. You've been signed out everywhere else.
account.regenerated: New codes generated. The previous ones no longer work.
account.signOutEverywhereDescription: Ends your session on all your devices and forgets remembered devices.
account.signOutEverywhereConfirmTitle: Sign out on all your devices?
account.signOutEverywhereConfirmDescription: You will be signed out here too and will need the code from your app to sign in again.

users.title: Users
users.description: Administrators and firing chiefs with access to PolvorApp.
users.caption: Users
users.inviteDescription: They will receive an email with a link, valid for 7 days, to create their password.
users.deactivateDescription: Their sessions will end and they will not be able to sign in until you reactivate them.
users.resetTwoFactorDescription: Their authenticator app and recovery codes will be removed, their sessions will end and they will have to set it up again the next time they sign in.

auth.invalidPassword: The password doesn't meet the requirements.

account.wrongCurrentPassword: The current password is not correct.

users.notInvited: The invitation can only be resent to users who have not accepted it yet.
users.notEnrolled: This user has not set up two-step verification.

email.sendFailed: The changes were saved, but the email could not be sent. Try again from the user's page.
